attendance.note: Stuff (19 Jan 2024): organisers praised for making 'this year's arrival of 8000 festival-goers' seamless. Press figure. NZ Herald (Jan 2021) reported up to 8,000 teenagers queueing; a Facebook-shared report said around 10,000 expected (year not shown).

audience.age_range: Teens and young adults; all-ages event with a large under-18 share
audience.psychographics: Youth summer camping festival in a surf town. Organiser says it exists to give young people space to connect, dance and discover; heavy duty-of-care setup (chill zones, Kaitiaki wellbeing teams, Know Your Stuff drug checking, sexual health team).

notes: Youth-skewed festival: press describes thousands of under-18s, so the adult share is low, which counts against an adult health brand despite the surf-town setting. About 8,000 attendees (2024 press). Health services on site (Know Your Stuff, Sexual Wellbeing Aotearoa, Peak Safety medics) are service providers, not sponsors.
